whenToUse: A season or event schedule of head-to-head matches with upcoming and past results — sports clubs, esports series, chess or debating leagues.
A team or player page that needs home/away and competition filters and marks the next match.
avoidWhen: A generic agenda of sessions or events without two opposing sides — use calendar or a list.
A ranking of sides — use standings-table.
a11y: Upcoming and Results are WAI-ARIA tabs with counts; each view is a captioned table with month row headers.
Scores are read as sentences ("Northgate 2, Riverside 1"), home/away tags and outcome squares have spoken names, and the filtered count is announced politely.
